name: Acer Cyber Security Inc.
summary: Acer Cyber Security Inc., a subsidiary of Acer Incorporated, delivers a comprehensive suite of cybersecurity solutions. The company's expertise spans key areas including security management, vigilant monitoring, meticulous auditing, proactive information sharing, and robust operational technology (OT) security. Their security management services assist organizations with the consultation and implementation of information security management systems (ISMS), personal information management systems (PIMS), and IT service management (ITSM) frameworks. This also involves conducting thorough risk assessments and audits for both general information security and personal data protection, complemented by essential security awareness training and orientation programs. For continuous protection, Acer Cyber Security provides extensive monitoring services. These encompass anti-hacking and antivirus surveillance, in-depth security incident investigation and analysis, and the planning and construction of Security Operations Centers (SOCs). They also leverage advanced AI and big data technologies for sophisticated threat analysis. The company's rigorous security auditing services feature simulated distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) exercises, comprehensive security health analyses, and vulnerability scanning for both systems and web applications. Further offerings include penetration testing, detailed mobile application information security analysis, source code reviews, and email alertness assessments. Moreover, Acer Cyber Security facilitates critical information sharing and OT security management. This includes the collection and analysis of intelligence regarding information security threats, the establishment and operation of platforms for information sharing and analysis centers (ISACs), and the evaluation of vulnerabilities and threats within industrial control systems. Beyond its service portfolio, the company develops and offers several proprietary tools. These consist of the eDC Cloudgoda Cloud portal, designed for managing and designing cloud architecture solutions; SAFE 3.0, a professional system for event log collection, preservation, analysis, and auditing; the Cloud Smart Portal, a comprehensive cloud management platform; Box101 for enterprise-grade cloud storage; and VDcooper, a desktop management solution. Acer Cyber Security Inc. caters to a diverse client base across industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, logistics, and e-commerce, in addition to supporting various government agencies. Founded in 2000, the company is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.
